title: Account Request State
description: Lifecycle state of an account request (experimental, account.requests). in_review and ambiguous are open; resolved and rejected are terminal for that request.

enumDescriptions.in_review: Someone has to act before the request can resolve. pending_action.waiting_on says whether that is the seller (review, matching against existing records) or the buyer (a human completes pending_action.url).
enumDescriptions.resolved: The request produced an account the caller can use. account_id and resolution are present.
enumDescriptions.ambiguous: The request matches more than one account the caller is already granted. candidates lists them; the buyer re-requests with the chosen account_id.
enumDescriptions.rejected: The seller declined, or a buyer action expired. Terminal for this request; errors explain why. A new request for the same key opens a new request.
